items.title: unregisterButton of an unknown id never answers
items.reason: the SDK documents no failure for an unknown id; the call hung in a device round

items.title: A pen-up element's uuid differs from getElements'; recognizeElements takes page elements only
items.reason: the SDK does not say which elements recognizeElements takes; device rounds showed it
items.upgradePath: an SDK release that recognises a pen-up element directly

items.title: Image Editing's facts about picture elements: their fields after an edit, and how far a reported rect may lie from the drawn picture
items.reason: the SDK does not describe a picture element's fields after an edit, nor whether its rect is the drawn frame; device rounds and the saved file showed them

evidence.source: Image Editing device rounds (#136); the record box of a picture and a text box against their five points, measured on the Mac on content.note (#324, #522)

probe.unprobed: needs a picture on a note page; the effect test is the Image Editing device round

items.title: An inserted PNG is copied into .data/plugin/ at the write
items.reason: the SDK does not say where an inserted picture's file lives; a device round showed the copy
items.upgradePath: an SDK call that names the inserted file

probe.unprobed: needs a picture insert on a note page

items.title: insertImage leaves a floating selection the host commits later
items.reason: the SDK does not say when an inserted picture reaches the page; a device round showed the delay
items.upgradePath: an SDK insert that answers once the picture is on the page

probe.unprobed: needs a picture insert on a note page

items.title: batchUpdatePageElements changes the page without drawing it; the host's code 0 is a redraw
items.reason: the SDK does not say whether a batch redraws the page; a device round showed none, and the host's redraw code is observed device behaviour

evidence.source: docs/supernote.md › Screen and units (#206); PluginHost's batch handler, observed device behaviour (docs/research/2026-11-native-paths.md)

items.upgradePath: an SDK batch that redraws the page, or answers whether it did

probe.unprobed: needs a conversion on a note page; the effect test is the Smart Pen device round (#296)
